artifacts.description: The ontology-led publication body: direct Symbolon records with Matheme, Mytheme, and Episteme as its three internal registers.
Governs preliminary setup, equal-base model branches, recursive writing and review, migration, and clean public release.
A content-agnostic record of linear, branching, rejoining, revisiting, and returning movement through a vault release.
Reads, follows, teaches, and investigates the published work through one QL/MEF instrument.

artifacts.boundary: Consumes a frozen reader-owned traversal snapshot and stable vault asset references to produce an optional Epi-Card engagement. It neither defines nor mutates the essay canon, vault architecture, source authority, or traversal history.

validation.scope: Specification, schemas, generated registries, examples, SQL parity, integrity manifest, skill wrapper, and links; no application runtime.
